components.name: site-header
components.behaviors: Contains site logo and search form; remains fixed at top of page.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves into logo (if link) then into search input; Enter activates logo link or search submit.

components.name: primary-nav
components.behaviors: Horizontal list of navigation links; indicates current page via aria-current="page".
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves through each link; Enter activates link.

components.name: search-form
components.behaviors: Accepts a search term and filters the relevant dataset (fashionArticles, beautyArticles, shoppingItems, or combined) showing results in‑place; displays empty state or message when no matches.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to input, type, Tab to submit button, Enter to submit; Escape clears input (not implemented but allowed).

components.name: hero-band
components.behaviors: Displays a prominent image at the top of the main content area.
components.keyboard_expectations: None (image is decorative; if made focusable would require tabindex).

components.name: content-band
components.behaviors: Wrapper for primary content sections; provides consistent spacing and heading structure.
components.keyboard_expectations: None structural; inner elements follow normal tab order.

components.name: card-grid
components.behaviors: Responsive grid displaying cards (articles, products, diary entries, etc.). Each card contains an image placeholder, title, and short description.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves into each card; links inside cards follow normal tab order.

components.name: sidebar
components.behaviors: Vertical aside containing lists of links (categories, popular, trending, etc.).
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves into the sidebar; links inside follow normal tab order.

components.name: modal-backdrop
components.behaviors: Full‑screen backdrop that appears when an image in the lookbook carousel is clicked; traps focus within the modal.
components.keyboard_expectations: Escape closes modal and returns focus to the triggering image; Tab moves focus within modal content.

components.name: modal-content
components.behaviors: Contains the enlarged image and close button; centered over backdrop.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves to close button; Enter activates close.

components.name: modal-close
components.behaviors: Button that closes the modal lightbox.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus reachable; Enter or Space activates close.

components.name: newsletter-form
components.behaviors: Email input and submit button; on submit shows a toast confirmation and clears the input (no actual submission).
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to input, type, Tab to submit, Enter to submit.

components.name: toast
components.behaviors: Live region that appears temporarily to confirm newsletter submission.

components.name: lookbook-carousel
components.behaviors: Displays a series of images; user can navigate via previous/next buttons or keyboard arrows.
components.keyboard_expectations: When carousel has focus, ArrowLeft/Right change slide; also works when modal is open (arrows change zoomed image).

components.name: carousel-prev
components.behaviors: Button to navigate to the previous slide in the carousel.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus reachable; Enter or Space activates previous slide.

components.name: carousel-next
components.behaviors: Button to navigate to the next slide in the carousel.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus reachable; Enter or Space activates next slide.

components.name: site-footer
components.behaviors: Contains copyright notice and simple text links.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab focus moves through each link; Enter activates link.
